Class HomCongruence {C : Category} (R : HomRel C) := { cong_incl ...; cong_sym ...; cong_trans ...; cong_comp ... }  (* R is a Prop-valued equivalence on each hom, containing ~ and compatible with composition *)

evidence.intree_statement: Definition Quotient (C : Category) (R : HomRel C) `{@HomCongruence C R} : Category := {| obj := @obj C; hom := @hom C; homset := fun x y => {| equiv := R x y; ... |}; ... |}
Definition QuotientLift : Quotient C R -> D := ... (a functor F : C -> D with (forall f g, R f g -> fmap[F] f ~ fmap[F] g) lifts uniquely through the projection)
Lemma QuotientLift_unique (G : Quotient C R -> D) (Hobj : forall x, fobj[G] x = fobj[F] x) (HG : ...) : forall x y f, hom_cast (Hobj x) (Hobj y) (fmap[G] f) ~ fmap[QuotientLift] f

statement_record.book: For functors F,G : C -> D agreeing on objects, define f ~ g on arrows of D by dom/cod agreement and: for every functor H : D -> E with HF = HG, H(f) = H(g). Prove ~ is a congruence on D and that the quotient D/~ (with the projection) is the coequalizer of F and G in Cat.
statement_record.intree: Quotient C R : Category (quotient of a category by a Prop-valued hom-congruence R), with QuotientProj : C -> Quotient C R and the lifting universal property QuotientLift / QuotientLift_unique (any functor identifying R-related arrows factors uniquely through the projection).
statement_record.strength_comparison: intree-weaker: the reusable engine of the exercise -- the congruence-quotient category plus its identity-on-objects projection and unique-lifting universal property -- is present in full and general form. But the exercise's two specific deliverables are NOT in-tree: (1) the particular relation 'H(f)=H(g) for all H:D->E with HF=HG' is never defined nor shown to be a HomCongruence, and (2) the conclusion that D/~ is the COEQUALIZER of F,G in Cat is never stated or proved (Cat is not shown to have coequalizers; grep of Instance/Cat* for 'coequalizer' returns 0 hits).
